title: Scenarios answer-flow contrast sweep and --color-matcha-strong token

spec.problem: The learner scenarios feature (apps/web/app/[locale]/scenarios) has multiple WCAG 2.1 AA contrast failures in light and dark modes across primary buttons, choice key prefixes, difficulty badges (including undefined --color-gold fallback #f59e0b), selected-choice and feedback state borders, borderline error text, unpinned feedback verdict and summary row text, progress bar fill, summary score readout, and unstyled error retry controls.

acceptance.text: AC1: globals.css defines --color-matcha-strong (#15803d light, #15853e dark and system fallback) while leaving --color-matcha (#22c55e light, #4ade80 dark) untouched; white text on matcha-strong >= 4.5:1 and matcha-strong border on dark paper/inner tint >= 3.0:1 in both themes.

AC2: scenario-play-client.tsx fixes primary CTAs (bg-matcha-strong text-white), choice key (text-ink/70), selected-choice and feedback borders (border-matcha-strong / border-sakura-strong), error text (text-sakura-strong), feedback verdict (explicit text-ink), progress fill (bg-matcha-strong dark:bg-matcha), summary score (text-matcha-strong dark:text-matcha), summary step rows (explicit text-ink + state borders), load-error/retry styling, and disabled choice hover/state without contrast washout.

AC3: scenario-list-client.tsx migrates all three difficulty badges (beginner matcha-soft + matcha-strong/dark:matcha, intermediate amber-soft + amber-strong removing undefined --color-gold, advanced sakura-soft + sakura-strong) to >= 4.5:1 in both themes, and styles load-error/retry with explicit high-contrast tokens.

AC4: Regression tests in apps/web/app/theme-contrast.regression.test.ts and scenario component/contract tests pin all computed before/after WCAG ratios (both modes) and rendered token classes; pnpm quality verify passes; WEB-439 closes VERIFIED with only owned files staged (no .build/, no tsconfig.tsbuildinfo).

spec.expected_behavior: Add --color-matcha-strong (#15803d light, #15853e dark + prefers-color-scheme fallback) in apps/web/app/globals.css without modifying --color-matcha. All text in scenario-play-client and scenario-list-client reaches >= 4.5:1 and all state/progress indicators reach >= 3.0:1 in both themes: primary CTAs 5.02:1/4.71:1; choice key text-ink/70 6.44:1/8.41:1 (paper) and >=5.97:1 (tints); level badges beginner matcha-strong/matcha on matcha-soft 4.79:1/8.48:1, intermediate amber-strong on amber-soft 6.84:1/10.39:1, advanced sakura-strong on sakura-soft 5.91:1/8.51:1; selected-choice and feedback borders matcha-strong 4.79:1/3.79:1 (inner 4.43:1/3.13:1) and sakura-strong 6.18:1/9.41:1; error text sakura-strong 6.18:1/9.41:1; feedback verdict explicit text-ink >=13.45:1; progress fill matcha-strong/dark:matcha 3.90:1/7.88:1; summary score matcha-strong/dark:matcha 5.02:1/8.40:1; summary rows explicit text-ink >=10.82:1 with matcha-strong/dark:matcha and sakura-strong borders >=4.61:1; retry buttons explicit text-ink on bg-surface >=13.45:1. Intentionally left subtle/decorative: loading pulse skeletons (bg-ink/10, bg-ink/5), speaker avatar circle (bg-ink/10 behind emoji), and subtle structural card borders (border-border) on cards/unselected choices.
spec.observed_behavior: In light/dark modes: (1) primary Next/Show Result and Replay buttons use bg-[var(--color-matcha)] text-white (2.28:1 light, 1.74:1 dark); (2) choice key A. uses text-ink/40 (2.52:1 light, 3.58:1 dark on paper); (3) level badges in scenario-list-client use matcha on matcha/15 (2.00:1 light), undefined --color-gold/#f59e0b on /15 (1.91:1 light), and sakura on sakura/15 (3.81:1 light, 4.26:1 dark); (4) selected-choice optimal border uses base matcha (2.18:1 light vs paper, 2.01:1 vs tint); (5) inline error uses base sakura (4.62:1 borderline light); (6) feedback verdict lacks explicit text-ink and panel borders use /20 (1.18:1-1.55:1); (7) progress fill uses base matcha on ink/10 track (1.77:1 light); (8) summary score uses base matcha on surface (2.28:1 light); (9) summary result rows lack explicit text-ink and state borders (1.09:1-1.24:1 tint vs surface); (10) list/play load-error retry buttons lack explicit text/border tokens and disabled choices retain hover.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert apps/web/app/globals.css (removing --color-matcha-strong), apps/web/app/[locale]/scenarios/**, and the WEB-439 describe block in apps/web/app/theme-contrast.regression.test.ts; no other features, API, DB, admin, or deploy files are affected.

classification.rationale: Presentation-only WCAG contrast token addition (--color-matcha-strong) and scenario list/play client token migration in apps/web; no API, database, admin, or domain logic changes.
